releases.title: Refine Reply Ideas
releases.description: Hover any reply-idea bullet, type a one-line of feedback, and the agent generates a tweaked version using the same tools the judge uses.

changes.text: Press `p` on a hovered reply-idea bullet to ask for a refined version steered by your typed feedback — runs the agentic loop with ask_naumu and web_search, then appends the new bullet so you can compare.
Green spinner placeholder sits where the new bullet will land while the agent thinks, with live progress (Thinking… / Browsing the web… / Asking Naumu…).

otherChanges.text: New About tab with release notes — this thing you're reading right now.
Config and Debug pages now share one section/group layout so jumping between them feels consistent.
Fix: deleted keywords no longer reappear after a restart — config.yaml now only seeds the keywords table on first boot.
Debug stats now show lifetime ask_naumu and web_search tool invocation counts so you can see how often the agentic loop is calling out.

releases.title: Long Break Visibility
releases.description: When the daemon takes a long break you can now see why and how long — no more wondering whether it's paused on purpose or stuck.

changes.text: Long break countdown surfaces in Debug → scheduling with active/quiet/pausing states.
Long break duration now jitters so the daemon's downtime is less predictable.
Active hours edit as two separate fields in Config.

otherChanges.text: Activity chart drops to a baseline dot for empty minutes so quiet stretches stay readable.

releases.title: Easier-On-The-Eyes Keyword Marker
releases.description: The CHANGE marker in the Keywords list now reads as suggestion instead of warning.

changes.text: Lighter sky-blue for CHANGE keyword suggestions so they don't fight with the rest of the row.

releases.title: Auto-Update Toggle
releases.description: xfarm can now keep itself current — flip auto-update on once and forget about it, or stick with the two-button banner.

changes.text: Auto-update toggle: enable it from the banner and new versions install themselves.
Update banner gained a second button so the choice between updating now and arming auto-update is one keystroke either way.

otherChanges.text: Tweet detail page reworked: meta box on top, a horizontally-divided stats card under the post.
Truncated tweet text is now refilled from the permalink, plus an 'o' shortcut to open the tweet.

releases.title: Judge With Web Search
releases.description: The judge can now hit the web mid-verdict, and the TUI shows what it's doing while it thinks.

changes.text: Judge gained web search and dedicated context/links fields so verdicts have grounding to point at.
Progress states render inline next to the spinner so a slow judge call no longer feels frozen.

releases.title: Drop The Pre-Push Hook
releases.description: The version-bump pre-push guard caused more friction than it caught — the agent now owns this responsibility outright.

changes.text: Removed the pre-push version-bump git hook.
The agent is now solely responsible for bumping `package.json#version` before every push.

releases.title: Header Stays Pinned
releases.description: The header and tab strip no longer scroll out of view when the body gets tall.

changes.text: Header pins across every page even at small terminal heights.
Dropped the # column from Candidates — it added clutter without much value.

releases.title: Steadier Candidate Order
releases.description: Viewing a candidate no longer reshuffles the list under you, and preflight is stricter so you find out about setup gaps sooner.

changes.text: `seen_at` updates no longer re-sort the Candidates list — selection stays put while you read.
Preflight checks are stricter and report missing pieces with more detail.

releases.title: Sharper Keyword Suggester
releases.description: Keyword suggestions are reframed around your actual workspace profile, and the version-bump rule is now part of the project conventions.

changes.text: Keyword suggester prompt rewritten to fit the AI-workspace-engineer profile.
CLAUDE.md captures the per-push version-bump rule so it doesn't get forgotten.

releases.title: Version Chip + Update Poll
releases.description: You can see which xfarm you're running at a glance, and the app checks for upstream commits every 30 seconds.

changes.text: Header shows the current version next to the title.
Background `git fetch` runs every 30s; the update banner appears as soon as upstream is ahead.
Pre-push hook reminds you to bump the version (later removed in 0.3.5).

releases.title: Update Banner & Bracketed Actions
releases.description: First proper release after the rebuild — adds the update banner, a candidates max-age knob, and a refreshed action style.

changes.text: Update banner appears when upstream main is ahead of your local checkout.
Candidates respect a max-age so stale tweets fall off without manual hiding.
Replies gate: candidates with no reply ideas are filtered out before they reach you.
Action rows render with `[ brackets ]` so the affordance is unambiguous.

otherChanges.text: Candidates list windows by terminal height so long lists no longer push the header off-screen.
Dockable XFarm.app installer and icon ship in the repo.
Fixed space key being dropped while typing in the keyword prompt.
After `git pull`, xfarm auto-relaunches in the same terminal.

releases.title: Pre-release
releases.description: Foundations xfarm was built on before v0.3.0 turned it into a proper release.

changes.text: Initial scaffold: scraping daemon, SQLite store, watchlist + per-keyword scanners.
Unified scheduler with quiet hours and home-feed visits.
Modular TUI with shared box/scroll/cursor utilities across Candidates, Keywords, Config, and Debug.
LLM provider abstraction (Vertex / Codex), pitch bullets and gate-at-discovery in the judge, chunked keyword-suggester merged into the keywords page.
